audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer gave LeBlanc the first four stages and called 6 through first item 'Skill' — the exact inverse of the content layer and the packet chart, which give Orianna level 1, call 2-5 skill, and hand LeBlanc 6 and first item.
audit.why: Kit-grounded: at level 1 she needs a second ability to detonate the Sigil and does not have one, so the opener is yours; Mimic at 45s is what makes the combo lethal at 6. The page had the lane backwards at every stage.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[].side moved to match win[], with every why rewritten to argue its new side.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes claimed level 6 doubles YOUR lane presence and asserted 'a third of a health bar' with no source, in a matchup whose level 6 belongs to her.
audit.why: Mimic is 45s at rank 1 and turns one basic spell into the burst; your R is 110s and 410 range. Calling 6 your spike inverts the matchup.
audit.corrected: Restated: Lost Chapter steadies mana, 6 is her one-shot window, two items and grouping take it back.

audit.whatIsWrong: The three interactions that decide the matchup were all absent. Sigil of Malice marks for 3.5s and only detonates when a second ability damages the marked target. Ethereal Chains shackles first and roots only if you stay shackled for 1.5 seconds. Mirror Image spawns a clone below 40% health that deals no damage — and the page never warns you not to spend a 110s Shockwave on it.
audit.why: Each one converts directly into an action: the mark is the tell, the 1.5s is your escape window, the clone is the trap. The page instead had generic 'punish the return spot' filler.
audit.corrected: All three now stated in cooldowns, tldr, enemyWin, breakdown.late and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit at all — 'four-second' was spelled out and nothing else was numeric (catalogue defect 3).
audit.why: It is the field whose job is real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Distortion 15s to 10s with its 4s return, Ethereal Chains 14s at 925 with the 1.5s shackle, Sigil of Malice 6s at 700 with a 3.5s mark.

audit.whatIsWrong: LeBlanc is called 'he/his' in tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, all six early phases[].why, three titles, three bodies and two report entries — while the content layer correctly says 'her' throughout.
audit.why: champ-data/champ-gender.js lists leblanc as female. The page currently contradicts itself within a single screen.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's own defect line: the page never names Mirror Image, Sigil of Malice, Ethereal Chains or Mimic. The content layer refers to them as 'her Q-chain', 'W' and 'R'.
audit.why: A reader cannot track a cooldown they cannot name, and letter-shorthand is what the calibration examples are about.
audit.corrected: Real names introduced across both layers; content whys[1], whys[3], whys[4], spikes[0] and spikes[1] now name the abilities.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization named Zed as the Zhonya's trigger in a LeBlanc matchup and omitted the Seeker's rush the content layer twice recommends.
audit.why: Template leak, and the two layers disagreed on the defensive buy.
audit.corrected: Seeker's early, Zhonya's before her level 6 combo.

notes: Chart: content win[] and the packet levelChart agreed exactly; phases[].side disagreed on all seven rows and had the lane precisely backwards — LeBlanc credited with levels 1-4 and the level 6 one-shot window called 'Skill'. Every side moved to match win[], and every why rewritten in the same proposal to argue the side it now names. phases[].rating (7,7,7,7,6,6,6) was built around the inverted chart — it falls as the matchup gets harder for you, which reads wrong now, but I could not tell from the kit whether rating means stage difficulty or stage advantage, so I left the whole rating column alone rather than guess. That is the one thing on this page I would still like corrected. The biggest single find is in breakdown.late: Mirror Image spawns a damage-less clone below 40% health and nothing on the page warned against spending a 110s Command: Shockwave on it. I did not assert anything about Cleanse, QSS or tenacity against Ethereal Chains — the kit does not carry that data — and instead wrote the one escape the text does support, which is leaving the shackle inside 1.5 seconds.
